text.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ

words.gloss_range: emphatic annulment particle governing the relative group and asserting the full predicate content

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed relative pronoun that opens the class under {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}})

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika hum khayru al-bariyyati}})
supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the resumed demonstrative-predicate judgment governed as the khabar content of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}})

words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens with assertion and syntactic government at once: it governs {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) and holds the whole later verdict within one confirmed proposition. Because 98:6 begins in the same emphatic register, the current ayah does not merely change tone; it reverses the verdict inside a matched frame. The opening also prepares a two-beat structure, first the believing-and-doing qualification and then the resumed restrictive judgment in {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika hum khayru al-bariyyati}}), while the doubled nūn gives the assertion audible pressure from the first word.

topics.headline: emphatic particle scopes the whole verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening assertion governs the full believing-and-doing class plus its final rank, not just the first word after it.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) as an emphatic annulment particle, and attachment evidence makes the relative group its governed ism with the demonstrative-predicate content as the khabar.

topics.headline: same opener asserts the positive counter-judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah answer the prior negative verdict in the same formal register, so the contrast comes through matched syntax as well as changed content.
topics.reason: The boundary rows compare the shared emphatic opening with 98:6, and the local clause supplies the positive predicate that reverses the prior verdict.

topics.headline: opener prepares qualification then resumed rank
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from an asserted class definition into a later restrictive verdict rather than hearing a loose descriptive sentence.
topics.reason: The clause evidence splits the relative qualification from the later nominal predicate, while {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika hum}}) resumes the group for judgment.

topics.headline: initial shaddah gives the assertion audible pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the assertion begin with compressed nasal weight before any content word is named.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is tied to the actual doubled nūn in the local particle {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}).

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun governed by the emphatic opener and filled by the following faith-action ṣilah

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the faith-action ṣilah that defines the relative class

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) makes the group grammatically identifiable by what follows: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāti}}). The rank is delayed until that relative definition is complete, so the ayah evaluates a class formed by belief and enacted sound deeds rather than by an inherited name. The later {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika hum}}) resumes this same span, and the return of the relative frame from 98:6 makes the positive content feel like an inverted answer to the prior ayah. In recitation, the nasal opener flows into this governed relative head as one opening unit before the action verbs arrive.

topics.headline: relative pronoun makes the class action-defined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ranked group is not named by lineage or label; it is grammatically defined by the actions in the following relative clause.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) as the governed relative pronoun whose ṣilah supplies the group's definition.

topics.headline: relative architecture delays evaluation until qualification is complete
topics.reader_payoff: The reader waits for belief and sound deeds before the predicate of rank arrives, so evaluation follows a completed criterion.
topics.reason: The relative clauses at words 3 and 4-6 fill the pronoun before the nominal predicate begins at word 7.

topics.headline: opened class is later resumed and restricted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the later demonstrative-plus-separator does not start a new group; it points back and locks the predicate onto this completed class.
topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence links {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) and {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) back to the span opened by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}).

topics.headline: same relative frame returns with inverted content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 98:7 reuses the relative-frame pattern of 98:6 while replacing rejection with belief and action.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete same-surah comparison to 98:6, and the local syntax confirms the same opening frame.

topics.headline: particle and relative pronoun sound like one opening unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the governed relative head joined closely to the emphatic opener before the action verbs begin.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is anchored in the immediate adjacency of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}).

words.prose: {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) is a Form IV perfect plural verb, so the class opened by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is qualified by an accomplished, agentive entry into faith and trust-security. Its {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}) field keeps trust, security, and reliability audible, while the local form prevents the sense from becoming mere safety or a request for protection. The plural ending routes agency back to the relative head and shares the long -ū cadence with the next perfect verb, so the two actions are heard as a pair. The verb also begins the familiar faith-action unit completed by {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāti}}), with compact formula parallels such as 95:6, 103:3, 85:11, and 84:25. Against 98:6, this same relative slot replaces rejection with trust before the ayah lands on the opposite creation-scale verdict.

topics.headline: Form IV faith carries trust-security entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees belief as an active entry into trust and security, while the local verb remains the faith verb rather than a request for protection or a mere state of being safe.
topics.reason: The local verb is Form IV perfect active with no explicit object; V4 supports the trust/security family, while QAC blocks replacing it with Form I bare safety or Form X seeking protection.

topics.headline: perfect plural routes agency back to the relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural class is already embedded in the verb ending as a completed qualification before the predicate resumes it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence controls the implicit 3mp subject by {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}), and QAC marks the verb as perfect active 3mp.

topics.headline: faith is the first half of a dense faith-action unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the verb is not isolated affiliation; it begins a recurrent Quranic criterion completed by righteous deeds, with parallels such as 95:6, 103:3, 85:11, and 84:25.
topics.reason: The contextual profile names {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) as the top partner for {{ar:أ م ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-n}}), and the local attachment coordinates the two verbs inside the same relative clause.

topics.headline: trust replaces rejection in the same relative slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 98:7 reverse 98:6 at the verb slot: trust-security answers covering or rejection before the final best/worst contrast is stated.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete 98:6 comparison, and local syntax places {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) in the same relative-clause position as the prior negative verb.

topics.headline: shared plural cadence links the two verbs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the two perfect verbs as a paired qualification before the object of work arrives.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is supported by the local coordination of {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) with {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}).

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small, but it is load-bearing: it keeps {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) under the same relative head as {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}). The result is cumulative qualification, not a second independent topic: faith moves into enacted work before the later {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) restricts the final predicate to this combined group. Its bound wa- also makes the transition sound continuous, so the action half follows faith without a heavy break.

topics.headline: conjunction keeps both verbs under one relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belief and work form one coordinated class definition, not two separate clauses or ranked groups.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) coordinated with {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) inside the same relative description.

topics.headline: single-letter connector binds tightly to the second verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the move into action as continuous with faith, not as a heavy restart.
topics.reason: The written and pronounced wa- is locally bound to the following verb, and attachment confirms that bound connector links the two verbs.

topics.headline: coordination feeds the later exclusive judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the group later singled out by the separator is the combined faith-plus-action group, so partial qualification is not the local target.
topics.reason: The later {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) restricts the predicate to the same span that the conjunction has built inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: wa pivots from inward trust to enacted work

topics.reason: The conjunction begins the second coordinated ṣilah segment, and the next verb has an explicit object that completes the action side.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect plural verb of deliberate doing, locally transitive with the explicit object of sound deeds

words.prose: {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) keeps the same plural subject as {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) and completes the qualification with an explicit object, {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}). Its second -ū ending completes the audible pair begun by the faith verb before the object names the deeds. The {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}) field makes this deliberate work rather than generic motion, while the Form I surface keeps it as direct performance, not making something else operate. In corpus terms the verb stands inside the dense faith-and-righteous-deeds formula, with echoes such as 95:6 and 103:3, and within the surah it turns the worship commanded in 98:5 into performed qualification before the best-of-creation verdict.

topics.headline: transitive work is completed by the righteous-deeds object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the action is not left generic; the verb requires and receives the concrete object named by the next word.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) as the object, and the contextual valency profile shows explicit-object use as dominant for this verb form.

topics.headline: second perfect plural keeps the same agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same relative class carry both completed actions, so the ayah does not divide believers from doers.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as perfect active 3mp, and attachment evidence makes its subject controlled by the same relative head as {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}).

topics.headline: ʿ-m-l names purposeful performance, not generic motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the deeds as deliberate performance and execution, while the local Form I verb keeps the sense on direct action rather than making something else work.
topics.reason: V4 supports intentional work and related use/employment branches, but QAC marks the local surface as Form I direct action, not a causative operating frame.

topics.headline: work joins the high-density righteous-deeds formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the work verb as part of a familiar Quranic formula in which faith is completed by sound deeds, with echoes such as 95:6 and 103:3.
topics.reason: Contextual evidence makes {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) the dominant partner for {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}), and the local object realizes that formula.

topics.headline: performed deeds answer the earlier command complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surah move from commanded worship in 98:5 to performed qualification in 98:7.
topics.reason: The rows give the concrete 98:5 comparison, and local syntax places the work verb inside the class definition that receives the closing verdict.

topics.headline: second ū-ending completes the audible verb pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the paired plural endings before the object names the deeds.
topics.reason: The sound observation is anchored in the coordinated perfect verbs {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟}} ({{tr:āmanū}}) and {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}).

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the transitive verb for which {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}) is the object that makes {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}) concrete. Its definite plural participial form names a recognized class of deeds characterized by soundness, repair, and fitness against corruption, not a vague good intention. Because it closes the sequence {{ar:ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāti}}), the ayah finishes the criterion before the demonstrative verdict begins. The assimilated article and heavy ṣād also make the object feel like a substantial landing point for the first beat.

topics.headline: definite object names a recognized deed-category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is a known category of deeds worked by the group, not a vague supplement or separate predicate.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a definite active participle used substantively, and attachment makes it the direct object of {{ar:عَمِلُوا۟}} ({{tr:ʿamilū}}).

topics.headline: soundness and repair define what makes the deeds count
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the deeds as acts characterized by soundness, repair, and order against corruption, while local grammar keeps that force on the object noun.
topics.reason: V4 supports soundness, rightness, repair, and reconciliation branches for {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}), and the local object position narrows those branches to the deed-category performed here.

topics.headline: active participial plural distributes soundness across acts
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees soundness spread across multiple performed acts, not reduced to one abstract concept.
topics.reason: The local form is a feminine plural active participle used as a noun, and contextual evidence shows this form class as common for the root.

topics.headline: object completes the faith-action formula before judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the defining beat close only when the quality-bearing object arrives; then the demonstrative verdict can begin.
topics.reason: The collocation profile tightly pairs {{ar:ص ل ح}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-ḥ}}) with {{ar:ع م ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-l}}), and the local clause closes the relative qualification at this object.

topics.headline: assimilated ṣād gives the object audible weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the definite deed-object arrive with compressed and weighty articulation at the end of the qualifying beat.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are anchored in the local sun-letter assimilation and doubled ṣād of {{ar:ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-ṣāliḥāti}}).

words.prose: {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) points back to the completed class, {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:alladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāti}}), and restarts the sentence as a verdict. The distal form marks distinction rather than physical distance here: the qualified group is set apart before {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) restricts the predicate. Its visible and recited lengthening slows the pivot into the verdict, giving the resumption weight before the rank is pronounced. Because 98:6 uses the same {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika hum}}) frame, the repeated syntax sharpens the reversal from the prior worst verdict to the current best verdict.

topics.headline: demonstrative resumes the completed qualified group

topics.reason: Cross-reference evidence links {{ar:أُولَٰٓئِكَ}} ({{tr:ulāʾika}}) to the span {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ}} ({{tr:alladhīna āmanū wa-ʿamilū al-ṣāliḥāti}}).

topics.headline: demonstrative prepares the separator's qaṣr

topics.reason: The demonstrative fixes the referent, and the following {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) functions as the separating pronoun before the predicate.

topics.headline: same demonstrative frame returns with the opposite verdict

topics.reason: The rows give the concrete same-surah frame comparison, and the local predicate supplies the positive pole.

topics.headline: madd slows the turn into the verdict

As the separating pronoun, it fixes {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) as the predicate and gives the clause restrictive force: they themselves are the ones ranked. The same separator frame appears in 98:6, so the grammar of restriction remains steady while the verdict flips. Its final nasal also gives a small audible seal before the superlative lands.

words.prose: {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) is the rank word of the ayah's closing predicate, stating a standing rank rather than narrating an event of becoming best. As an elative construct head before the definite genitive {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}}), it reads as an absolute superlative, 'best of' the named class rather than a weak comparative. The {{ar:خ ي ر}} ({{tr:kh-y-r}}) field adds goodness, benefit, and selectedness; the variant {{ar:خِيَارُ}} ({{tr:khiyāru}}) makes the choice pressure audible, while the canonical word remains the quality-ranking elative. A common evaluative term is made locally exceptional by attaching to the faith-action class and the rare creation-scale phrase, with faith-context echoes such as 3:110 and 2:103. Across the boundary with 98:6, {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) occupies the same predicate slot as {{ar:شَرُّ}} ({{tr:sharru}}), making the current phrase the positive pole of one shared creation-scale verdict. Its short-heavy close resolves into the genitive scale as one final predicate unit.

topics.headline: elative predicate states rank, not becoming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a standing rank in a nominal clause, not on a narrated event of becoming best.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) as the nominative predicate after the demonstrative-pronoun frame, and attachment makes the phrase the predicate of word 7.

topics.headline: construct with definite genitive makes the rank maximal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the word as 'best of' a definite creation-scale domain, not merely 'better' in an unspecified comparison.
topics.reason: Attachment forces {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}}) as the genitive complement, and the elative construct with a definite complement yields an absolute superlative reading.

topics.headline: goodness and selectedness converge under canonical bestness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the predicate as both qualitative excellence and chosen fitness, while the canonical surface still ranks the group as best rather than replacing it with a plural 'chosen ones' noun.
topics.reason: V4 supports goodness, excellence, benefit, and choosing branches; the qiraat {{ar:خِيَارُ}} ({{tr:khiyāru}}) exposes selection pressure, but QAC keeps the canonical local form as the elative {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}).

topics.headline: khayru is the positive pole of the adjacent best/worst scale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees 98:7 answer 98:6 with the opposite superlative in the same predicate slot and over the same scale.
topics.reason: The boundary rows give the concrete 98:6 phrase {{ar:شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:sharru al-bariyya}}) and the local phrase {{ar:خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:khayru al-bariyyati}}).

topics.headline: common elative becomes exceptional in this faith-action frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a common evaluative word intensified by its attachment to the faith-action class and the rare creation-scale phrase, with formula echoes such as 3:110 and 2:103.
topics.reason: The contextual profile shows the elative as common, while the CRITICAL rows tie this occurrence to faith contexts and the marked local complement.

topics.headline: superlative and scale sound as one closure unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rank begin and resolve into its genitive scale as a single final predicate unit.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is tied to the local iḍāfa between {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) and {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}}).

words.gloss_range: definite collective genitive completing the superlative phrase as the comparison domain
words.root_gloss_range: the recorded root side includes truth, righteousness, kin-kindness, sound, land, grain, fruit, and overcoming branches; the local noun is also derivationally contested with creation-root pressure, so the phrase selects creation or created beings as the comparison scale

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the elative construct head completed by {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}})
the hamzated reading that makes the creation-root pressure visible
the creation-root alternative in the derivational dispute around {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}})

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}}) completes the iḍāfa and names the field over which {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) ranks the group. Its definite collective form gathers the comparison domain into one class, pushing the phrase toward 'best of creation' rather than an open-ended excellence claim. The word is derivationally charged: the canonical surface is aligned here with {{ar:ب ر ر}} ({{tr:b-r-r}}), while the hamzated reading {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيئَةِ}} ({{tr:al-barīʾati}}) exposes {{ar:ب ر ء}} ({{tr:b-r-ʾ}}) creation pressure; the local predicate keeps that pressure creation-scale, with land-creature imagery secondary. Since the noun occurs as the matched closure of 98:6 and 98:7, it becomes the fixed scale on which worst and best are opposed. As the ayah's last word, its doubled-yā weight makes the scale audible as the verdict lands, and its rank-only ending leaves 98:8 to supply the reward location.

topics.headline: collective genitive supplies the total comparison domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verdict measured within a definite collective field, not left as an undefined excellence claim.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-bariyyati}}) as a definite feminine singular collective in genitive iḍāfa with {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}).

topics.headline: bariyya narrows toward created beings while retaining land-creature pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final noun as a creation-scale term, with the land or embodied-creature derivation still visible but subordinated to the local best-of-creation frame.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows document the disputed {{ar:ب ر ر}} ({{tr:b-r-r}}) and {{ar:ب ر ء}} ({{tr:b-r-ʾ}}) derivations; the local superlative iḍāfa and hamzated qiraat {{ar:ٱلْبَرِيئَةِ}} ({{tr:al-barīʾati}}) support creation-scale narrowing without erasing the canonical surface.

topics.headline: feminine singular collective treats many beings as one class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the comparison field is grammatically gathered into one collective noun under the superlative.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a feminine singular collective used as the genitive complement of the superlative.

topics.headline: rare repeated noun fixes the best/worst scale across 98:6 and 98:7
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same rare scale noun carry opposite predicates in adjacent ayahs, so each verdict defines the other's scope.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the exact form as low occurrence, and the CRITICAL rows give the concrete adjacent pair in 98:6 and 98:7.

topics.headline: last word lands the verdict on its maximal field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close only when the scale itself is named, with the sound weight matching its load-bearing role.
topics.reason: The word is the final element of the iḍāfa and the ayah's last word, completing the scale over which {{ar:خَيْرُ}} ({{tr:khayru}}) operates.

topics.headline: rank-only closure prepares the next ayah's reward location
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 98:7 names rank without location, creating pressure for 98:8 to specify the garden dwelling.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete forward link to 98:8, while the local ayah closes on evaluative scale rather than spatial reward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence at words 3-5 is predicated as khayr al-bariyyah at words 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled assent becomes intentional action that opposes corruption; khayr then evaluates this integrated disposition as chosen excellence within the field of created beings.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent supplies inward confirmation rather than a bare group label.
Intentional doing turns assent into purposive enactment.
Soundness opposed to corruption specifies the action's corrective quality.
Virtue and chosen excellence supply the evaluative force of the predicate.
Creation fixes the comparison class as created beings.

changed_reading.before: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best creatures.
changed_reading.after: Those whose settled assent becomes deliberate anti-corruptive action are marked as the choice among created beings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Amana, amila, and al-salihat at words 3-5 can form a trust-to-reconciliation sequence under the predicate at words 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Security and trust issue in dealings that remove estrangement between people; excellence is therefore measured by beneficial repair within created social life.

activation_trace.role: Settled security and trust provide the relational condition from which repair can proceed.
Dealings between people locate action in concrete social exchange.
Reconciliation and removal of hostility make those dealings reparative.
Desired beneficial good makes social benefit the axis of excellence.
Created beings supply the community in which the repair has effect.

changed_reading.before: The verse commends private belief plus an unspecified stock of good deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse commends trust made socially operative through dealings that remove hostility and produce benefit among created beings.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Amila and al-salihat at words 4-5 stand immediately before the evaluation khayr al-bariyyah at words 8-9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Putting capacities to work and fitting action to its object produce benefit; excellence can thus be heard functionally as the right use of created capacities.

activation_trace.role: Putting something to work supplies an operational rather than merely classificatory sense of action.
Suitability and fitness govern whether the applied capacity matches its object.
Beneficial good supplies the outcome by which fitting use is valued.
Creation supplies the larger order whose capacities are being used fittingly.

changed_reading.before: Good deeds are a generic moral list qualifying a superior group.
changed_reading.after: The superior created response is to put capacities to fitting, beneficial use.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from disclosed meaning through purified pages and upright contents to fragmentation after disclosure. This revises faith from mere exposure to evidence into a settled response demonstrated by reparative action.

activation_trace.role: Inwardly settled confirmation supplies the receptive response whose quality is being tested.
Intentional action makes reception observable as conduct.
Reconciliation supplies the cohesive alternative to post-disclosure division.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the initial evidence event.
Purity and removal of stain intensify the clean presentation of the evidence.
Uprightness and evenness characterize the disclosed writings as normatively straight.
Repeated disclosed meaning marks the same clarity as preceding the divergent response.
Scattering into parts supplies the outcome that clear presentation alone does not prevent.

structural_cues: 98:1 introduces al-bayyinah; 98:2-3 identifies recited purified pages with upright writings; 98:4 places division after its arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, purity, uprightness, and later fragmentation; I infer that 98:7 distinguishes transformed reception from mere exposure. A live alternative is that 98:4 reports a sequence without defining faith in 98:7.

changed_reading.before: Faith is assent to sufficiently clear evidence, followed by good deeds.
changed_reading.after: Clarity can precede fragmentation, so faith here is the settled, enacted reception of disclosure that bears cohesive and reparative fruit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Obligation, exclusive devotion, directional orientation, maintained worship, giving, and growth unfold al-salihat as a coordinated practice. It orders the agent while circulating benefit outward.

activation_trace.role: Intentional doing receives concrete content from the preceding command sequence.
Soundness opposed to corruption unifies the practices as corrective work.
Request and obligation frame the practices as a demanded order rather than optional sentiment.
Submissive worship supplies the governing orientation of the practice.
Exclusive separation from association makes the governing orientation undivided.
Inclination toward a direction makes the orientation active and chosen.
Care, preservation, and charge make establishment a continuing work of maintenance.
Specified worship supplies the recurring embodied practice being maintained.
Giving supplies the outward transfer that complements worship.
Growth and increase make the transfer productive rather than merely subtractive.

structural_cues: 98:5 coordinates a purpose of exclusive worship with establishing prayer and giving zakah, then names the whole a q-w-m order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation, exclusive direction, established worship, giving, and growth; I infer that they form one maintenance-and-circulation mechanism under al-salihat. They may alternatively be salient examples rather than a complete definition.

changed_reading.before: Righteous deeds remain an open, generic moral category.
changed_reading.after: Righteous deeds are concretized as an undivided and maintained praxis joining worship to growth-bearing social transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored verdicts place concealment and evil opposite settled assent and beneficial excellence while retaining the same creation class. Khayr becomes a contrastive judgment on response, not free-floating superiority.

activation_trace.role: Settled confirmation supplies the positive response opposed to covering truth.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the enacted positive pole.
Beneficial good supplies the positive evaluative pole opposite evil.
Created beings supply the comparison class shared by both verdicts.
Covering truth supplies the negative response opposed to settled confirmation.
Evil and harm supply the negative evaluative pole mirrored by khayr.
The repeated creation branch confirms that both verdicts divide one creaturely field.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 repeat the frame inna alladhina ... ulaika hum ... al-bariyyah while replacing kufr/sharr with iman, corrective action, and khayr.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact syntactic mirroring and lexical opposition; I infer that the classification turns on a response pattern to disclosure. The mirror could alternatively rank groups without making that response the semantic content of khayr.

changed_reading.before: Best of creation is an isolated superlative attached to one group.
changed_reading.after: Within one created field, the verdict polarizes responses: truth covered into harm versus truth settled into beneficial repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recompense meets intentional work with nurturing completion, continuing provision, permanence, and mutual satisfaction, while reverent awe names the inward orientation. Excellence becomes a completed relationship rather than a static rank.

activation_trace.role: Intentional work supplies the human action answered in the following verse.
Beneficence and gift open the predicate toward an answering generosity.
Action met by its recompense supplies the response linking deed and outcome.
Nurture, repair, and completion make the relation developmental rather than merely transactional.
Continuity of provision and giving turns the reward into sustained beneficence.
Stable persistence keeps the completed relation from quickly passing away.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocal ratification rather than one-sided approval.
Fear with reverent awe supplies the inward orientation beneath the enacted response.

structural_cues: 98:8 opens with 'their recompense,' resumes the group in 98:7, states satisfaction in both directions, and closes by naming the beneficiary through khashyah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recompense, nurture, ongoing giving, permanence, mutual satisfaction, and awe; I read the outcome backward as interpreting khayr through a fulfilled relation. It may alternatively describe only a consequence of an already complete moral ranking.

changed_reading.before: Khayr al-bariyyah is a static status earned by prior qualities.
changed_reading.after: Their excellence is a trajectory: reverent orientation becomes intentional repair and is completed by enduring provision and mutual satisfaction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrival of disclosed clarity activates an opening-and-disentangling image; together with corrective action and the clearance branch under bariyyah, this permits a transformation reading in which excellence is release from corrupt entanglement.

activation_trace.role: Correction opposed to corruption supplies the condition into which release would move.
Clearance and separation provide a form-distant echo inside bariyyah for disentanglement.
Opening what is closed and separating what is entangled supply the release mechanism.
Appearance and uncovering supply the clarity event at the mechanism's threshold.

structural_cues: 98:1 places a hatta boundary between being unseparated and the arrival of al-bayyinah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entanglement-opening and appearing clarity; I supply the causal arrow that disclosure can release a receptive subject into repair. The negated munfakkin hatta construction may mark persistence up to arrival without asserting that release follows.

changed_reading.before: The verse only ranks an already defined class of believers and doers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also register a post-disclosure transformation: assent and repair are the marks of release from corrupt entanglement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant Sh-R-Y mapping under sharr in 98:6 and economic side branches of amal and khayr. It remains anchored by the focus verse's work and gift branches and by 98:8's explicit recompense. Downstream prose should present it as an exchange analogy, never as a lexical replacement for sharr or khayr.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Amila at word 4 and khayr at word 8 carry wage, transaction, and gift branches within the focus ayah.

activation_trace.role: Wage for work supplies the possibility that action has a due return.
Interpersonal transaction gives the work-return relation a social exchange form.
Gift and beneficence recast khayr as generosity entering the exchange.
The non-dominant buying-and-selling branch activates the odd exchange frame from the mirrored verdict.
Recompense matching action supplies the packet's explicit settlement of the exchange.

changed_reading.before: Khayr is only an intrinsic moral superlative.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, intentional reparative work establishes one side of a value exchange answered by gift and fitting recompense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because bariyyah directly selects the creation branch, not the recovery branch. It remains anchored in the same focus root and converges with salih as anti-corruption plus contextual purification, growth, and restorative completion. Downstream prose should call it a root-echo of creaturely recovery, not translate bariyyah as convalescence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-salihat at word 5 and al-bariyyah at word 9 join corrective action to a root whose inventory also contains recovery from illness.

activation_trace.role: Making sound against corruption supplies the reparative action.
Recovery from illness supplies the form-distant convalescence image within the focus root.
Purity through removal of stain supports a clearing phase in the recovery image.
Purity and soundness connect prescribed giving to restored condition.
Repair, nurture, and completion extend recovery into a sustained creaturely process.

changed_reading.before: Best of creation is solely a rank within a fixed created class.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified root-echo, the best created response participates in making creaturely life sound, cleared, and restored.

strongest_changes: The 98:1-4 arc shows that disclosure can precede fragmentation, making faith in 98:7 an enacted reception rather than mere possession of clarity.
98:5 concretizes al-salihat as maintained, undivided worship joined to growth-bearing social transfer.
The mirrored verdict in 98:6 and the recompense in 98:8 move khayr from an isolated superlative to a contrastive relationship completed in enduring mutual satisfaction.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports inward settlement, social reconciliation, and fitting use at once; context then turns these into a disclosure-response test, a maintained practice system, and a reciprocal outcome. The split Sh-R-R mapping also preserves a contained exchange analogy that a conservative synthesis would likely lose.
remaining_uncertainties: The reconciliation branch of salihat may be a secondary resonance rather than the plural's governing sense.
98:8 may interpret khayr retrospectively, or it may only state the consequence of a ranking already complete in 98:7.
The release, exchange, and convalescence readings are mechanistic root echoes and should not be promoted to direct lexical translations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Trust stabilizes the heart after fear and division.** Evidence: ء م ن B001 settled security/trust and B002 confirming truth; ف ر ق in 98:4 B009 heart split by fear; خ ش ي in 98:8 B001 reverent fear. Structural cue: the surah moves from division after proof to faith and then fear of the Lord. Assigned role: īmān settles what tafarruq and khashya could scatter. Abductive move: I infer that true fear becomes trust rather than panic when directed to the Lord. Reading change: “believed” is not just assent; it is the heart’s secure reception of the proof.

2. **Righteous works repair the social rupture.** Evidence: ع م ل B001 intentional doing and B003 assigned charge; ص ل ح B001 soundness against corruption and B002 reconciliation; ب ر ء B002 clearance/separation. Structural cue: 98:4 reports communal rupture; 98:5 gives enacted obligations; 98:7 names work that is ṣāliḥ. Assigned role: work turns faith into repair, and ṣalāḥ removes فساد and نفار. Abductive move: I infer that صالحات are acts whose rightness is visible in repaired relations, not merely private merit. Reading change: the believers are “best of creation” because they enact repair after proof, not because belief remains internal.

3. **Goodness as chosen/beneficial createdness.** Evidence: خ ي ر B001 desired good/opposite evil, B002 chosen excellence, B005 beneficence; ب ر ء B001 creation and B003 recovery. Structural cue: 98:6’s شر البرية is answered by خير البرية. Assigned role: khayr marks both moral opposite and selected excellence; barīyya keeps the creaturely frame. Abductive move: I infer that creation reaches its best state when faith and action align with benefit and repair. Reading change: “best” is not a static rank but a healed, chosen mode of creaturely life.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:8’s reward “عند ربهم” made خير البرية less comparative and more relational: their goodness is recognized near the Lord who created and nurtured them. The final “لمن خشي ربه” also surprised the īmān reading by making secure trust coexist with reverent fear.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Faith as settled trust made visible by intentional work.** **Lexical evidence:** `ءَامَنُوا` anchors `ء م ن` B002, “trusting assent and confirmation,” with B001, “settled security and trust”; `عَمِلُوا` anchors `ع م ل` B001, “intentional doing and work.” **Structural cue and role:** the two verbs are coordinated before a single classification, after the packet has presented voiced sheets, command, prayer, and giving. Trust supplies inward settlement; work supplies purposive external realization. **Abductive move:** I infer that the coordination makes action the visible continuation of assent rather than an unrelated second credential. **Reading change:** faith reads as reliance stable enough to organize deliberate conduct, not as bare acknowledgment of the proof.

2. **Sound acts as repair of post-disclosure fragmentation.** **Lexical evidence:** `ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰت` anchors `ص ل ح` B001, “soundness and rightness against corruption,” and activates B002, “reconciliation and settlement between people.” **Structural cue and role:** 98:4 has made social scattering the central post-proof failure, while 98:5 prescribes exclusive orientation, maintained prayer, and material giving. The reconciliation branch assigns sound acts a social repair role in addition to individual rightness. **Abductive move:** I infer that acts opposite the displayed fragmentation include restoring relation; the plural noun does not enumerate reconciliation. **Reading change:** `ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰت` becomes conduct that repairs a damaged shared order, not only a collection of private merits.

3. **Chosen excellence emerging from choices.** **Lexical evidence:** `خَيْر` anchors `خ ي ر` B002, “virtue and chosen excellence,” and B003, “choosing or seeking the better option”; `ٱلْبَرِيَّة` anchors `ب ر ء` B001, the created field. **Structural cue and role:** 98:6–98:7 hold `ٱلْبَرِيَّة` constant while reversing the appraisal, and the present clause inserts faith and work before `خَيْر`. The choice branch turns excellence into the outcome of response. **Abductive move:** I infer that those appraised as choice become so through their choosing under disclosure; the text states deeds before rank but not this lexical causality. **Reading change:** “best of creation” is dynamic excellence selected through enacted response, not a status detached from action.

4. **Goodness as beneficence that circulates.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `خَيْر` also activates `خ ي ر` B005, “beneficence and gift.” **Structural cue and role:** 98:5 has just made granting growth-purity (`يُؤْتُوا ٱلزَّكَاة`) a core practice, and 98:8 answers the sound actors with recompense, gardens, flow, and approval. The gift branch assigns `خَيْر` an outwardly productive role rather than a merely comparative one. **Abductive move:** I infer that the givers’ beneficence and the later grant form a reciprocal circulation; the packet gives the sequence, not a quid-pro-quo formula here. **Reading change:** the “best” are characterized by good that moves through them, and their outcome continues that movement.

5. **Intentional acts as legible inputs to a matching outcome.** **Lexical evidence:** `عَمِلُوا` anchors `ع م ل` B001, intentional action; later `جَزَاؤُهُمْ` activates `ج ز ي` B001, recompense matching an act. **Structural cue and role:** the work clause immediately precedes the reward description, while 98:8 makes the outcome possessive (`جَزَاؤُهُمْ`). Intention makes the acts attributable; recompense makes their consequence proportionate. **Abductive move:** I infer a causal ledger from adjacency and the lexical match branch; the packet does not detail how each act maps to each feature of the outcome. **Reading change:** `عَمِلُوا` is not generic activity but accountable, purposive input whose pattern becomes externally realized.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:8 supplied the decisive later activation: `جَزَاؤُهُمْ` (`ج ز ي` B001) made the intentionality of fixed `ع م ل` B001 causally legible as input to a matching outcome. The gardens’ continuing provision and the mirrored approval also expanded fixed `خ ي ر` B005 from abstract goodness into beneficence that circulates and returns. No further correction was needed to the paired faith-work mechanism; the later ayah specified its realized form.

baseline.text: Kuşkusuz inanan ve iyi işler yapanlar, işte onlar yaratılmışların en iyileridir.

findings.text: İman, açık kanıtı kabul eden yerleşik güvenin amaçlı davranışta görünür hâle gelmesidir; eylem inancın ayrı bir eki değil dışa vurumudur.
İyi işler, yalnızca bireysel erdemler değil, kanıttan sonra bozulan ortak düzeni onaran ve uzlaştıran üstlenilmiş işlerdir.
Yaratılmışların en iyisi olmak, eylemden bağımsız hazır bir statü değil, açıklık karşısında daha iyiyi seçerek oluşan bir üstünlüktür.
İyilik, zekâtla başlayıp bahçeler ve karşılıkla geri dönen, kişiden çevresine geçen üretken bir yarar niteliği kazanır.
Amaçlı işler, sonraki karşılığın biçiminde dış dünyada karşılığını bulan, kişiye yüklenebilir girdiler hâline gelir.
İmandaki güven, sonraki Rab korkusuyla çelişmez; bilinçli saygıyı paniğe dönüşmekten alıkoyan bir iç yerleşiklik sağlar.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **98:7.** إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ — Birincil okuma: İman edip salih işler yapanlar yaratılmışların en hayırlısıdır. Önceki ayrışma ve sonraki Rab korkusu birlikte düşünülünce iman, sadece tasdik değil kalbin güvene yerleşmesi; salih amel de parçalanmayı onaran, yaratılmışlığı en iyi hâline taşıyan bilinçli eylem olur. {ء م ن B001; ء م ن B002; ع م ل B001; ع م ل B003; ص ل ح B001; ص ل ح B002; خ ي ر B001; خ ي ر B002; ب ر ء B001; ب ر ء B003}

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person is directed, straightened, and cleansed for undivided service.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual posture extends into lowered submission, purification media, and places built for worship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Purified Character and Righteous Work
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Defilement is removed from the self, growth is made clean, and intentional work repairs what is wrong.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: moral purification `ط ه ر:B005/m01`; purity and increase `ز ك و:B002/m01`; filtering refinement `خ ل ص:B001/m01`; repair and righteousness `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; moral good `خ ي ر:B001/m01`; expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cleansing, growth, repair, and work form one ethical process: contamination is removed, capacity develops, and the resulting action restores fitness. Expiation supplies the remedial counterpart when action has incurred a stain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A person is directed, straightened, and cleansed for undivided service.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Ritual posture extends into lowered submission, purification media, and places built for worship.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Invocation, Amen, and Blessing
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A worshipper names the divine, addresses the lord, asks for blessing, and seals the utterance with amen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: divine invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; amen response `ء م ن:B003/m01`; supplication and blessing `ص ل و:B002/m01`; lordship addressed `ر ب ب:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Naming opens the address, lordship identifies the addressee, supplication carries the request, and amen supplies the answering assent. The result is a compact call-and-response ritual.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Conviction and Learned Discernment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A claim is inwardly assented to and interpreted through knowledgeable, delegated judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: belief and assent `ء م ن:B002/m01`; knowledge carried by fear-language `خ ش ي:B002/m01`; learned religious guide `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; delegated adjudication `د ي ن:B007/m01`; denial `ك ف ر:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belief is presented as a settled cognitive act rather than mere safety. Learned interpretation and delegated judgment give it a disciplined frame, while denial provides the opposing refusal to assent.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Security Held Beside Awe
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Trust establishes safety while reverent fear and alarm keep the subject alert.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: security and trust `ء م ن:B001/m01`; awe and apprehension `خ ش ي:B001/m01`; fear after separation `ف ر ق:B009/m01`; skittish aversion `ن و ر:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Security and fear are not simple opposites here. Trust supplies a stable relation, while awe, alarm, and skittish recoil regulate approach to what carries authority or danger.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: excellence and selection `خ ي ر:B002/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; fitness `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; worthiness `ء ه ل:B003/m01`; compatibility `ز ك و:B004/m01`; evil `ش ر ر:B001/m01`; ingratitude `ك ف ر:B004/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What does not yet exist is formed, sustained, and capable of being raised again.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Creation and resurrection share an image of standing into renewed existence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Formation into Existence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A created being comes into occurrence and is nurtured toward a repaired, viable state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: creation and formation `ب ر ء:B001/m01`; occurrence and existence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; nurture and repair `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; activation `ع م ل:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Origination is not an isolated instant. Coming-to-be is followed by nurture, repair, and activation, producing a causal sequence from formation to functioning life.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What does not yet exist is formed, sustained, and capable of being raised again.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rising Again
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Created beings stand into a renewed state whose duration can extend without end.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Debt Collection and Discharge

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: debt `د ي ن:B003/m01`; collection of what is due `ج ز ي:B003/m01`; clearing a right or debt `ب ر ء:B004/m01`; attached liability `ت ل و:B004/m01`; demand to take `ع ن د:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Liability follows the obligated party until collection or release. The same accounting relation can therefore terminate either in payment or in a formal clearing of the outstanding right.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An office-holder receives authority, supervises affairs, and maintains a governed charge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reaches payrolls, civic enrollment, coronation, and maritime command.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Workers are entered into a register, assigned service, and maintained by wage or stipend.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The register fixes membership, office assigns function, and recurrent payment sustains the worker. Writing thus operates as a practical technology for coordinating labor and livelihood.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Shared relations are allocated, negotiated, repaired, or broken by hostility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Consultation and Reconciliation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Parties deliberate, choose a course, and remove mutual aversion through reciprocal assent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: counsel `ء م ر:B007/m01`; mutual satisfaction `ر ض و:B003/m01`; reconciliation `ص ل ح:B002/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Shared relations are allocated, negotiated, repaired, or broken by hostility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Contractual Manumission
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An enslaved person enters a written installment agreement that ends ownership and clears the claim.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The written contract transforms release into a staged legal process. Payment or performance clears the owner's right, and the formerly bound person exits the relation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A fastening, obligation, affiliation, or claim is opened so that its parties can part.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Courtship or marriage is terminated by a separation whose legal effect cannot simply be reversed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A fastening, obligation, affiliation, or claim is opened so that its parties can part.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Station and place supply stability, the hiding place supplies protection, and trust names the resulting condition. Staying converts temporary refuge into residence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reaches night, meridian shadow, month endings, layered cloud, and sparks.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Menstrual and Postpartum Clearance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bleeding ceases, washing follows, and an adolescent or postpartum woman returns to a cleared state.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: menstrual clearance `ب ر ء:B005/m01`; cessation of menstruation `ط ه ر:B002/m01`; washing `ط ه ر:B003/m01`; maiden `ج ر ي:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cessation marks the biological boundary, washing performs the hygienic transition, and clearance names the restored state. The maiden motif places the process within a broader female life cycle.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Frame, Limbs, and Joints
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body is assembled from jaws, chest bones, limbs, joints, and a curved foot.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: jaws `ف ك ك:B004/m01`; chest bones and rib ends `ج ن ن:B016/m01`; working legs `ع م ل:B010/m01`; working eye `ع م ل:B010/m02`; anatomical separation `ف ر ق:B007/m01`; limb separation `ب ي ن:B008/m01`; curved foot `ح ن ف:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The branches map a load-bearing frame whose parts meet at separable joints. Curvature and separation make bodily alignment visible by showing where the frame can deviate or come apart.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Convalescence and Release from Illness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Disease loosens, the patient separates from the afflicted state, and ordinary function returns.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recovery `ب ر ء:B003/m01`; convalescence `ف ر ق:B010/m01`; escape from constraint `خ ل ص:B002/m01`; cleansing wash `ط ه ر:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Recovery is expressed as separation: illness releases its hold and the patient exits it. Washing removes residue, while convalescence names the interval in which restored function becomes stable.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spearhead fitting `ء م ر:B011/m01`; spear shaft and forepart `ع م ل:B009/m01`; short arrow `ر س ل:B011/m01`; chest-bone forepart analogy `ج ن ن:B016/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Shaft and fitted point provide the actual assembly, while short arrow and chest forepart extend it by scale and shape. The shared invariant is a rigid forward member designed to project force.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Jewelry, Necklace, and Crown
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Small joined pieces become wearable ornaments and, at the highest rank, a crown.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earrings and bracelets `خ ل د:B003/m01`; necklace `ر س ل:B011/m02`; crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; craftspeople `ع م ل:B006/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A hunter hides in a blind, lures prey from shelter, and catches it in a snare or trap.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: snare `ش ر ك:B006/m01`; trap `ص ل و:B004/m01`; hunter's blind `ب ر ء:B007/m01`; concealed refuge `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; luring an animal from its burrow `خ ي ر:B006/m01`; sudden snatch `ن ه ر:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Concealment protects the hunter, lure initiates movement, and trap converts that movement into capture. The snatch is the abrupt terminal action of the same tactical sequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Small Prey, Serpent, and Blindness
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Small harmful creatures inhabit concealed ground and are pursued or detected despite impaired sight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: serpent `ج ن ن:B012/m01`; blind burrowing rodent `خ ل د:B005/m01`; gnat-like irritant `ش ر ر:B009/m01`; lure from a burrow `خ ي ر:B006/m01`; intact-looking blind eye `ق و م:B021/m01`

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Counsel and Measured Deliberation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A matter is approached through counsel, slow delivery, comparison, and settled resolve.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: counsel `ء م ر:B007/m01`; deliberate measured delivery `ر س ل:B004/m01`; resolve `ق و م:B003/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; workable avenue `ء ت ي:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counsel opens the question, measured delivery slows premature action, and comparison selects a workable route. Resolve is the point at which deliberation becomes commitment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Futility, No Choice, and Strain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Effort continues after useful options have closed and produces strain without benefit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lack of utility `ب ع د:B009/m01`; no way or choice `ع ن د:B005/m01`; exertion and trouble `ع م ل:B007/m01`; adverse condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: No-choice closes the decision space, futility removes expected gain, and effort becomes pure strain. The adverse condition is therefore both the cause and outcome of ineffective action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Purposeful Work and Performance
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Intention activates a task and coordinated participants carry it through as performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: intentional work `ع م ل:B001/m01`; activation and use `ع م ل:B002/m01`; reciprocal performance `ر س ل:B008/m01`; answering voice `ت ل و:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Intention defines the task, activation begins it, and reciprocal performance distributes it across agents. The answering voice gives coordinated work an audible call-and-response form.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Labor Crew, Wage, and Stipend
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A crew performs assigned labor and receives recurring support for its livelihood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`; wage `ع م ل:B004/m01`; stipend `ج ر ي:B006/m01`; livelihood `ق و م:B009/m01`; enrolled service `ك ت ب:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The crew supplies collective agency, enrollment fixes obligation, and wage or stipend sustains continued service. Livelihood is the stable outcome of repeated compensated work.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Willing Gift and Welfare
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A giver voluntarily presents a benefit in response to another's need.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: giving and bestowal `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; willing transfer `ر س ل:B010/m01`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; blessing and benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Need supplies the receiving condition, willing transfer preserves the giver's agency, and gift supplies the concrete benefit. Blessing names the surplus value by which the transfer becomes welfare rather than bare exchange.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods enter a thriving market, parties transact, and demand establishes value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: thriving market `ق و م:B018/m01`; reciprocal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`; commercial partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m02`; standing appraisal `ق و م:B010/m01`; yield offered for exchange `ء ت ي:B007/m01`

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal inanma ya da dua cevabi degil; korkudan emin olma, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak olarak bu dali korkunun ziddi olan guven, kalbin yatismasi ve guven verme alaninda toplar. Ayni iddia guvenilir kisi, emanet, guvenli yer ve dayanilir binek gibi turemis ya da baglamli kullanislari da cekirdege baglar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Korkunun kalkmasi, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme ve guvenilir sayilma alanlarini birlikte tasiyan en kisa genel karsiliktir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali acikca tasdik, haber ya da vaadi dogru sayma ve bazi dini kullanislarda hakka boyun egme olarak verir. Provisional cerceve guvene dokunan yanini not eder, fakat dal kimligi korkusuzluk degil tasdik ve kabul iliskisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal guvenlik hali degil; bir soz, haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru kabul etme alanidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Hem genel tasdik adlari hem de belirli soz obekleri ve dini kullanislar vardir; tanim bunlari yalin guven anlamina genisletmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir haber, vaat veya hakikati dogru sayip ona icten kabul ile yonelmektir. Dini kullanista bu kabul, kalp, dil ve davranisla baglanan bir boyun egme ya da seriate girme anlami kazanabilir.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek bir haberin, sozun veya hakikatin dogru sayilmasidir.
Hakka yonelik ic kabul, yalniz bilmekten ziyade boyun egme ve kabullenme bicimi alir.
Dini alanlarda bu kabul, bildirilen yola girme ve ona baglanma adi olarak kullanilir.
Ilahi sifat kullaniminda vaat edilen odulu dogrulama veya guvenceyle bildirme boyutu one cikar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalin ortak cekirdegini tasdik olarak verir ve bir sozun dogru sayilmasini temsil eden ornegi buna baglar. Ayni iddia, daha ozel dini kullanimlarda hakka icten boyun egme, yola girme ve vaatle ilgili dogrulama boyutlarinin eklendigini de gosterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Haber, vaat, hakikat ve dini baglanma kullanimlarini tasdik cekirdegi etrafinda birlestirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil kalıplı kullanımlar verir; tanım bu iki beden parçası örneğini genelleştirmeden açıklar.

concept_map.definition: Belirli tamlamalarda bedenin iş gören parçasına verilen addır: hayvan için ayaklar, bir örnekte uzağı gören göz. Bunlar çıplak bir genel organ adı olarak genelleştirilemez.

facets.statement: Kalıplı kullanımlarda bedenin iş gören parçasını adlandırma ortak çerçevedir.
Hayvan için bu ad, onun ayaklarına uygulanır.
Uzağı gören göz örneği de kalıplı ve şiirsel bir kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı kalıplı beden parçası adlarıyla sınırlar; hayvanın ayakları ile uzağı gören göz aynı yalın anlam değil, iki özel kullanımdır.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, hayvanın ayaklarını ve uzağı gören gözü aynı kalıplı beden parçası alanında verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanın ayakları veya uzağı gören göz gibi kalıplı beden parçası kullanımlarında açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıplı beden parçası, iş görme ve iki özel örneği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın yürümeyi sağlayan üyeleri anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvana ilişkin ayaklar kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Uzağı gören göz örneğini ve ortak iş gören parça çerçevesini daraltır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözün uzak görüş yeteneğiyle anıldığı örnekte uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Göz ve uzak görüş örneğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Hayvanın ayakları kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca işlek, yürünmüş ve belirgin yol niteliğini verir. Bu anlam iş yapmak, işçi topluluğu veya yaya yolcu adlandırması değildir.

facets.statement: Yürünmüş ve işlek hale gelmiş yol ana anlamdır.
Yolun açık ve belirgin oluşu anlamın ayrılmaz parçasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı kalıplı biçimde işlek ve belirgin yol olarak verir; çalışma veya işçi alanına genişleme yoktur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu kolu yolculukta binek kullanmadan yürüyen kişiler için kalıplı bir topluluk adı olarak verir. İşçi topluluğu ve yolun kendisi bu kapsamda değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam yaya yolcuları adlandıran kalıplı topluluk ifadesidir; el işçileri ve işlek yol anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik profil kalıplı kullanım verir; tanım yalnız yaya yolcu topluluğu ifadesi için geçerlidir.

facets.statement: Yolculuk eden kişilerin yaya gitmesi ana anlamdır.
Adlandırma kişilere yöneliktir, yolun kendisine veya işçilere değil.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, anlamı yolculuk sırasında yürüyerek giden kişiler için kalıplı bir adlandırma olarak sınırlar.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynaklı tanıklık, bu topluluk adını binek kullanmadan yürüyen yolcularla sınırlar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök ailesi, bilinçli iş yapma çekirdeğinden çalıştırma, görevlendirme, ücret, karşılıklı işlem, işçi topluluğu, zahmet, işe yatkınlık, nesne parçası, beden parçası, işlek yol ve yaya yolcular gibi ayrı kollara açılır. Kolların çoğu iş alanıyla ilişkili olsa da bazıları yalnız kalıplı adlandırmalar veya nesne adları olarak korunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalın çekirdeğini bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durum olarak kurar; ayrıca bu duruma gelmeyi, bir şeyi bu duruma getirmeyi ve belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranmayı da kapsar. Geçici çerçeve bu durum, süreç ve ettirgen işlem ayrımlarını doğru biçimde bir arada tutmaktadır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kişiler, işler ve şeylerdeki iyi durum ile bu durumu sağlama bu dala girer; kişiler arası uzlaşma, uygunluk ve özel adlar ayrı dallardadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yalın biçimlerdeki iyi ve düzgün olma çekirdeğini, düzeltme türevlerini ve yalnızca belirli yapıda görülen iyi davranma kullanımını birbirine karıştırmadan kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin, işin ya da şeyin bozukluğun karşıtı olan iyi ve düzgün durumda bulunması veya bu duruma gelmesi; ayrıca bir şeyi bozukluktan arındırarak iyi duruma getirme işlemidir. Belirli bir yapıda bir canlıya iyi davranma anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Kişi, iş veya şey bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün ve yararlı bir durumda bulunur.
Bir şey kendiliğinden iyi ve düzgün duruma gelebilir ya da bir etken bozukluğu gidererek onu bu duruma getirebilir.
İyi duruma getirme, iyi yaratma, var olan bozukluğu giderme veya bir kimsenin iyi olduğuna hükmetme yollarıyla gerçekleşebilir.
Belirli bir yönelme yapısında anlam, bir hayvana iyi davranmaya kadar uzanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni bozukluğun ve kötülüğün karşıtı olan iyi, düzgün durumdur. Bu eksen kişinin ve işin iyi olmasını, bir şeyi düzeltmeyi, yarar sağlayan şeyi, iyi duruma getirmeyi istemeyi ve özel bir yapıda hayvana iyi davranmayı kapsar; insanın iyi yaratılması, bozukluğunun giderilmesi veya iyi sayılması da düzeltmenin farklı gerçekleşmeleri olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın hem durum ve duruma gelme çekirdeğini hem de bozukluğu gidererek iyi duruma getirme işlemini birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İyi ve düzgün durum, bu duruma gelme ve bu durumu sağlama ayrımlarını korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayımlanan beş karşılaştırma, dal içi karışmaları, temel karşıtlığı, alanla sınırlı yakın anlamı ve genel iyilikle sınır farkını gösterir; kalan adaylar ya yalnızca örnek, özel alan veya ortak senaryo paylaşır ya da kişi ve yer adı dalları olarak anlamsal çekirdeği kesmez.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه صلاح الشيء والرجل والعمل، والإصلاح نقيض الإفساد، والمصلحة والاستصلاح، والإحسان في مثل أصلحت إلى الدابة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الصلح بمعنى المصالحة بين الناس، ولا الأعلام الشخصية أو الموضعية.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد يدل على خلاف الفساد (maqayis)؛ الصلاح نقيض الطلاح ورجل صالح ومصلح وأصلحت إلى الدابة أحسنت إليها (ayn)؛ الصلاح ضد الطلاح وصلح الرجل صلاحا وصلوحا (jamhara)؛ الصلاح ضد الفساد والاصلاح نقيض الإفساد والمصلحة والاستصلاح (sihah)؛ الصلاح ضد الفساد مختصان في أكثر الاستعمال بالأفعال وإصلاح الله تعالى الإنسان (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uzaklık ve soğukluğun giderilmesini karşılıklı barışma ve uzlaşmayla açıklar. Geçici çerçeve bu kişiler arası sınırı korur ve genel anlamdaki iyi olma ya da bir nesneyi düzeltme anlamını bu dala taşımadığı için kaynakla uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca insanlar arasındaki soğukluk, çatışma veya uzaklığın barışmayla giderilmesini kapsar; genel düzgünlük ve nesne onarımı kapsam dışıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın dalın kişiler arası barışma çekirdeğine dayanır ve başka dallardaki genel iyi olma, düzeltme veya uygunluk anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluk, uzaklık veya çatışmanın giderilerek tarafların karşılıklı biçimde barışması ve uzlaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Birbirinden uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış insanlar arasındaki olumsuz ilişki giderilir.
Taraflar karşılıklı olarak barışır ve aralarında uzlaşma oluşur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bu anlamı insanların kendi aralarında barışması ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi olarak ortaklaşa verir; ad ve eylem biçimleri aynı karşılıklı uzlaşma olayını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsanlar arasındaki soğukluğun veya çatışmanın giderilip karşılıklı barışın kurulmasını eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiler arası olumsuz ilişkinin giderilmesini ve tarafların karşılıklı uzlaşmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Daha önce uzaklaşmış veya çatışmış tarafların yeniden iyi ilişki kurduğu bağlamlarda doğal bir açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki olumsuz ilişkiyi, bunun giderilmesini ve karşılıklı barışmayı birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: barışma, uzlaşma ve aradaki soğukluğun giderilmesi
